subject: How to stop the deleting of output folders on error?

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: How to stop the deleting of output folders on error?
parts:
Hi,

How to stop the deleting of output folders on error.  The important reason I ask is the Hadoop install I am on puts the job log in the output folder as _logs.  Rhipe deletes it.  I want to stop that.  Also is it impossible to use a map expression and use debug="count"?

> res = rhwatch(map=map,setup=setup,input= rhfmt("BEND/State/Daily",type="map"),output=("BEND/Exported/State/Daily"),readback=FALSE, verbose=TRUE,parameters=parameters,mapred=mapred,debug="count")
Error in rhwatch(map = map, setup = setup, input = rhfmt("BEND/State/Daily",  : 
  RHIPE: for debugging purposes, must use a map expression returned  by ewrap

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] How to stop the deleting of output folders on error?
parts:
Hmm,

1. If there is an error Rhipe:::.rmr or rhwatch or one of those automatically deletes the output - hardcoded. will need a change
2. The messahe should be or debugging purposes, must be a function
because RHIPE inserts handlers around the code. This could be done in map=expression() but isn't. you'll manually have to insert your own trycatch

sorry about that

Wishlist: stop a job upon error, but dont delete the output so that i can examine with say debug='collect' .. a bit tricky however
